Iâm Nia (neonsten/nyeeeon) ABOUT ME follow me! :d Twitter Twitter Twitch Twitch YouTube YouTube Patreon Patreon Facebook Facebook Discord Discord TikTok TikTok Instagram Instagram VGen VGen Art COMMISSION STATUS Waitlist open â§ COMMISSION â§ FAQ â§ PAYMENT â§ VTUBER CHILD About me Hi! Iâm Nia (also known as Neonsten or nyeeeon) I prefer to go by Neon or Sten online :D Iâm a freelance Live2D Animator and Digital Illustrator from Thailand. I graduated with a degree in 2D/3D Animation, and I am currently pursuing a Masterâs degree in Business. Iâve been drawing for as long as I can remember :D I just really like drawing and animating, haha! In 2019, I dropped out of Law school to study Animation. During the COVID lockdowns, I started streaming on Twitch because I wanted to make new friends. At first, I didnât even have a microphone, so my streams were just muted, cozy art streams. As I got more comfortable, I started talking on stream and eventually debuted as a VTuber in 2021. Somehow, chat also got me into metal and rock music! I like to think it made me at least 20% cooler. Thanks, bros! You guys made me cultured xD As my community grew, I started feeling a little insecure because people would sometimes ask if I was faking my voice or using a voice changer. I just want to clear that up, I have absolutely no idea how to use one. You could ask my OG viewers if I sounded like this back when I stream with my built-in laptop mic (the quality was ass IIRC). Apparently, I was just born with this voice! Soâ¦ if youâve ever wondered, now you know. I also have a little cat-dragon mascot named Goongeon! Lore-wise, Iâm a water dragon because Iâm a weird little Capricorn/Aquarius combo, and my birth year is the Goatâ¦ so thatâs why my horns look somewhat goat-like. It all makes sense if you donât think about it too hard xD I stream mostly in English, but I also speak Thai! I grew up in northern Thailand, where we have our own dialect. Then I got yoinked to central Thailand, went to an English school, and somehow managed to nerf both my Thai and my English in the process ð (Somewhere along the way, my northern vocab fadedâ¦) I also like cats and jasmine tea. Now you know a little more about me.
